title: Interstellar Navigation Beacons Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Interstellar Navigation Beacons operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Interstellar Navigation Beacons installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 64748 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where pulsar clocks monitoring, beacon logistics redundancy, or lane charting maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Interstellar Navigation Beacons Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Interstellar Navigation Beacons: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Interstellar Navigation Beacons — pulsar-timed beacons marking safe lanes between stars.

Phase 1 — Prove (pulsar clocks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (beacon logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (lane charting): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (signal maintenance): beacon hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and interstellar lanes-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
